units metal
atom_style full
boundary p p p
read_data silicon.data

# Define interatomic potential
pair_style sw
pair_coeff * * /potentials/Si.sw Si

# Define settings
neighbor 2.0 bin
neigh_modify delay 5

# Initial velocities
velocity all create 300.0 12345

# Equilibration and heating
fix 1 all npt temp 300.0 2500.0 100.0 iso 0.0 0.0 1000.0
thermo 1000
timestep 0.001
run 1000000  # 1 ns = 1000 ps

# Equilibration at 2500K
unfix 1
fix 2 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 100.0 iso 0.0 0.0 1000.0
thermo 1000
run 500000  # 500 ps

# Output MSD for diffusion calculation
compute msd all msd
fix 3 all ave/time 100 1 100 c_msd[4] file msd.txt
run 500000
